nodes.title:
Retell architecture (verified).
- Retell-operated hosts are US-West: sip.retellai.com AWS us-west-2 EC2, mcp.retellai.com an ELB in us-west-2, neither geo-routed; api.retellai.com is Global Accelerator anycast. Support (t/1949, 2026-03-25): 'Retell infrastructure is only in US(west) region.'
- Not every media edge is US-West: the legacy LiveKit Cloud project (retell-ai-4ihahnq7.livekit.cloud) resolves Indian client subnets to 143.223.94.x, the /24 LiveKit labels 'production-ohyderabad1a-main'.
- Browser media moved in Sept 2026 from LiveKit Cloud to a Retell-operated WHIP-style gateway (web SDK 3.0; create-web-call returns 'gateway' only). The gateway keeps LiveKit's room and identity-token model; its server software is unknown.
- The SIP allowlist has 3 LiveKit Inc. blocks (which include LiveKit's Mumbai and Hyderabad /24s) beside AWS us-west-2. Inference: some PSTN media lands on LiveKit addresses.
- Retell describes its own call-scheduling queues, containers and workers in two postmortems (vendor-claimed). Whether the runtime is built on LiveKit Agents, Pipecat or its own code is unknown.
- STT: Deepgram, Soniox, Azure, AssemblyAI and an unexplained 'Muse'. TTS: ElevenLabs, Cartesia, MiniMax, Fish, OpenAI, Inworld and 'Platform' (mostly re-listed MiniMax/Fish/Cartesia voices, per the account phase).

Retell all-in INR per connected minute for an Indian outbound call, computed from the rate card (not billed; ex GST, FX 95, 60 s call, Platform voice).
- BYO Indian SIP trunk, prompt up to 4k tokens: INR 8.3-13.6.
- Same with a 6k-token prompt: INR 8.7-20.0, depending on whether the 4,000-token rule scales only the LLM line or the whole duration.
- Retell-managed US number dialling India: INR 22-37 (Twilio USD 0.15, Telnyx USD 0.25 per min). This +1 path cannot carry BFSI service calls, which must come from 1600-series numbers.
The BYO band is 1.2-3.8x the lowest Indian list band (3.55-7), inside the 8-18 band other Indian vendors post, and 2.8-6.8x VP's INR 2-3 target; the infra line alone is INR 5.2/min. Caveats: the transcript counts toward the 4,000 tokens, so long-call rows are optimistic; whether an Indian trunk may terminate on a US SIP edge at domestic rates is unverified. The calculator-default margin is unknown (no price for its LLM in the cited inputs).
nodes.n: observed rate card x 3 telephony paths x 3 TTS x 3 LLM x 4 call lengths x 2 prompt sizes (324 rows; re-run byte-identical by the verifier)
nodes.method: Computed with pricing_allin.py from the public pricing page and docs read on 2026-10-20 (re-fetched 19:27Z, unchanged) and VP's Indian telephony input INR 0.43/min on 30-s pulses (2026-10-18 model inputs.csv). Not a billing measurement; RET-P11 tests the scaling rule.

nodes.title:
Retell does nothing India-specific for compliance (verified).
- 0 mentions of TRAI, DLT, NCPR, DPDP, DND or data residency across the 338 docs pages and the OpenAPI.
- Numbers are US/CA only (one docs page contradicts this), and caller-ID trust services are US-only; an Indian CLI needs a BYO SIP trunk.
- Calling windows default to America/Los_Angeles, with no TRAI window or warning.
- The internal DNC flag is off by default, honoured by single calls only with honor_internal_dnc=true, and NOT checked by batch calls.
- PII categories are US-centric (no Aadhaar or PAN).
- Active support runs 9 AM-9 PM Pacific: 21:30-09:30 IST until 2026-11-01, 22:30-10:30 IST after.
An Indian buyer carries all TRAI and DPDP work alone. Post-sale is not uniformly lighter: BFSI service calls must come from 1600-series numbers (ledger REG-10, REG-20), which Retell cannot supply.

Retell's Indic coverage is thin.
- Six Indian locales of 63: en-IN, hi-IN, kn-IN, mr-IN, ta-IN, ur-IN. No Telugu, Bengali, Gujarati, Malayalam, Punjabi, Odia or Sarvam; kn/mr/ta/ur ASR is Azure or Soniox only.
- Forum threads show Hindi digits mis-transcribed, with staff blaming the default Deepgram ASR (t/2713), and Indian multilingual drift back to English (t/2502, 330 views).
- Telugu and Bengali requests got 'try GPT Realtime' (t/1645); Sarvam requests are unanswered (t/2856, t/2866); some Indian browser users intermittently fail to join web calls (t/1949, where staff say the infrastructure is US-West only).

Retell's outbound surface and data model (verified).
- Batch calls take a CSV with any column as a dynamic variable, plus time windows and reserved concurrency. They have no per-call pacing, no documented retries and no DNC check. The API can only create a batch.
- A 'Campaigns' object exists server-side: the OpenAPI lists 'campaign' as a dashboard dataset, and the DNC doc refers to per-lead attempts and campaign DNC settings. It has no docs page and no endpoint; its retry and pacing fields are inferred from marketing.
- Strong diagnostics: 39 disconnection reasons, per-call cost line items, per-component latency, PCAP download, live listen and take-over.
- Hidden price multipliers: prompts over 4,000 tokens (including transcript and KB) scale billed duration; a 10-s minimum on a dynamic opener; burst +USD 0.10/min on the entire call. The marketing line 'No minimums' contradicts the 10-s rule.

Retell reliability and velocity, 2026-04-20 to 2026-10-20 (verified).
- Reliability: 12 status incidents (6 major). 2026-09-05: a custom-LLM race stalled the fleet; the degradation grew undetected for about 6 h (10:00-16:00 PST, no queue monitoring existed), and the first status post came 39 min after the 16:10 fleet-wide failure. 2026-09-16: a deploy double-assigned calls and failed about 22% of calls for 43 min; paged 7 min after errors rose, public post 35 min after.
- Velocity: 80 retell-sdk releases, 16 deprecation notices (2026-04 to 2026-12), 4 marketing changelog posts (none since 08-24), web SDK 3.0 on 09-08, spec revision 2026-10-19.
- Company: USD 80M ARR with 50 staff (vendor job posts).
nodes.n: 12 incidents in 6 months (50 most recent incidents returned by the status API, back to 2025-03-14); 80 npm versions; 16 deprecation notices
nodes.method: Read status.retellai.com/api/v2/incidents.json (capped at the 50 most recent), npm registry metadata, docs llms.txt and the changelog page on 2026-10-20; durations from incident timestamps and postmortem text, re-read by the verifier

nodes.title:
Retell v2 notes (verified).
- Contact memory is one rewritten brief of at most 2,000 characters per phone number, updated after phone or SMS conversations; saving is off by default for new agents and web calls don't save. Marketing's 'resume where the last call left off' describes that summary; it is not retrieval over history (consistent with ledger CMP-01's verifier note).
- Learning: Conductor turns failed calls into simulation tests and proposes fixes for human approval; AI QA cohorts cost USD 0.10/min; A/B uses fixed weights. No autonomous optimisation, bandit or significance test is documented.
REA inspect-web-network-capture on a full Playwright HAR with embedded response bodies.
nodes.tried: REA 6.7.0 inspect-web-network-capture on the full dashboard-login HAR with embedded response bodies (lane-reported 15.5 MB including a 6.9 MB PNG; the full HAR was not kept).
nodes.broke: Decoder failed with 'Capture decoder failed unexpectedly (RangeError)'. The same HAR with bodies and cookies stripped (120 KB) decoded cleanly. Workaround: slim every HAR before giving it to REA. REA analyze-web-bundle over a local CDP Chromium worked on the pricing page (40 scripts, 0 parse failures).

nodes.closes_when: Predictions RET-P01 to RET-P12 in predictions.json are scored, using each prediction's verifier_check scoring fix, against a run on our own Retell trial workspace (Instinct reported it ready, USD 10 credit, TOTP on every login), with stereo handset recordings, PCAPs and a time-and-motion log.

nodes.title: Retell's legacy LiveKit Cloud web host is geo-routed and has an Indian edge; Retell's own hosts are not. Client-subnet DNS (22 lookups, 19:25Z): retell-ai-4ihahnq7.livekit.cloud gives Indian subnets 143.223.94.99/.107 (RDAP label 'production-ohyderabad1a-main'), a us-west-2 subnet San Jose, 8.8.8.0/24 Phoenix, the sandbox Ashburn; sip, api and mcp.retellai.com give every subnet the same records. The SIP allowlist's LiveKit blocks also hold LiveKit's Mumbai and Hyderabad /24s. So 'US-West only, no other PoP' holds at most for Retell-operated compute; whether Indian PSTN media on a BYO trunk lands on an Indian LiveKit edge is open (a PCAP shows it).

Inference: Retell has no compliant path for BFSI post-sale calls in India. Service and transactional calls by RBI/SEBI/IRDAI/PFRDA entities must come from 1600-series numbers irrespective of consent (ledger REG-10, REG-20). Retell numbers are US/CA only, so its +1-to-India route (INR 22-37/min) is out for an insurer's or intermediary's renewal call; a BYO trunk must carry a 1600 number, which takes about 7-14 business days to provision, has no published price, and no CPaaS states it may stream media to a third-party AI gateway (REG-23 to REG-25), let alone a US-hosted one. For VP's insurance-renewal beachhead, post-sale on Retell is different plumbing, not lighter plumbing.

Retell has a platform AI-disclosure control: the Agent Handbook preset 'AI Disclosure When Asked' (HandbookConfig.ai_disclosure, ~30 tokens), documented as on by default for new agents; agents built through Retell's Claude connector also open with 'Hi, this is an AI assistant.' The account phase found an API-created agent with no handbook_config at all, so the default depends on the creation path. Two pre-registered predictions (RET-P03, RET-P12) rested on 'no disclosure control documented' and now carry corrected scoring.

Adversarial verification of the retell lane: 41 of the lane's 60 claims re-checked against their evidence (manifest 471/471 hashes match; DNS re-run with 4 client subnets; rate card re-fetched; pricing_allin.py re-run byte-identical; OpenAPI enums, SDK source, HAR, status API and 8 threads re-read). 23 confirmed, 14 corrected, 4 downgraded (RET-22, RET-24, RET-33, RET-36), 0 whole claims refuted (5 sub-statements refuted and fixed in place: the 'US-West only' hosting summary, 'post-sale needs less' for BFSI, 'INR 3 needs Indian hosting', and the 'no disclosure control' basis of RET-P03 and RET-P12), 7 added (RET-22b, RET-36b, RET-47b, RET-61 to RET-64). Biggest changes: Retell's legacy WebRTC edge has an Indian PoP; BFSI post-sale needs 1600 numbers Retell cannot supply; the calculator-default margin and the 'not LiveKit Agents' claim are unknown; AI disclosure is a platform preset. 7 of 12 predictions are only partly falsifiable as registered and all 12 carry scoring notes; RET-P01's sign-up clause was known before registration. Record: per-claim verification fields in claims.json, verifier_check in predictions.json, raw re-checks under data/teardown/retell/verify/ (report.md and verify.md were refused by the harness).

events.details:
Retell lane finished the account-free phase: 60 graded claims and 12 pre-registered predictions; the harness refused its report.md.
- Read: 356-page docs index and 338-page corpus; OpenAPI (109 ops, revision 2026-10-19); pricing, changelog and status API; job board; DNS/RDAP; the web SDK source (npm pack, not installed); a slimmed dashboard-login HAR; REA web-bundle of the pricing page; 19 India community threads.
- Hosting: Retell-operated hosts US-West; browser media moved from LiveKit Cloud to a Retell-operated WHIP gateway in Sept 2026; 3 LiveKit IP blocks in the SIP allowlist.
- Price: India INR 8.3-13.6/min on a BYO trunk, 22-37 via Retell US numbers (computed); prompts over 4k tokens scale billed duration.
- India: 0 TRAI/DLT/NCPR/DPDP mentions; US/CA numbers only; LA-default windows; batch calls skip DNC; 6 Indian locales, no Sarvam.
- Velocity: 12 incidents (6 major) and 80 SDK releases in 6 months. USD 80M ARR (vendor).
- Tooling: REA failed on the full HAR (RangeError) and worked once it was slimmed.

Adversarial verifier on the retell lane: 41 of 60 claims re-checked, 23 confirmed, 14 corrected, 4 downgraded (RET-22, RET-24, RET-33, RET-36), 0 whole claims refuted (5 sub-statements refuted and fixed in place: the 'US-West only' hosting summary, 'post-sale needs less' for BFSI, 'INR 3 needs Indian hosting', and the 'no disclosure control' basis of RET-P03 and RET-P12), 7 added; 19 out-of-scope claims not re-checked. Re-runs: manifest hashes 471/471; client-subnet DNS (22 lookups); pricing page re-fetch (unchanged); pricing_allin.py (byte-identical).
- New: the legacy LiveKit web host geo-routes Indian clients to LiveKit's Hyderabad edge, so 'US-West only' holds only for Retell-operated hosts.
- New: BFSI post-sale needs 1600-series numbers, which Retell cannot supply; its +1 route is out for insurance renewals.
- New: an 'AI Disclosure When Asked' preset exists (on by default in the docs; absent on API-created agents per the account phase).
- Unknown now: the calculator-default margin (no price for its LLM in the inputs) and whether the runtime is built on LiveKit Agents or Pipecat.
- Predictions: 7 of 12 are only partly falsifiable as registered and all 12 carry scoring notes; RET-P01's sign-up clause was known before registration. The harness refused report.md and verify.md; the text is in the structured output and the per-claim record in claims.json.
